How this works

No surprises at checkout. Here is the whole process.

Order lands in WhatsApp

Your full order, sizes and a reference number arrive in our business WhatsApp the second you check out. A human replies, usually within the hour.

Pay how you like

Card, instant EFT, or arrange it in the chat. Nothing is charged before you have confirmed the pair is in your size.

Checked before it ships

Every pair is inspected and photographed here before it goes out. What you see on the product page is the actual pair you receive.

Delivered in 48 hours

Courier to any major centre in two working days, outlying areas in three to four. Tracking number sent to your WhatsApp.
